[
  {
    "target_block_id": "03",
    "target_block_family": "Output_Schema",
    "mutation_type": "strengthen_json_only_rule",
    "priority": 1,
    "reason": "Fix invalid JSON output failures by enforcing strict JSON-only output without markdown or comments.",
    "edit_instruction": "Add or strengthen micro-rules to ensure the output is exactly one JSON object with no extraneous formatting or text.",
    "proposed_micro_rule": "Return exactly one JSON object only; never emit markdown, prose, comments, or code fences."
  },
  {
    "target_block_id": "03",
    "target_block_family": "Minimality",
    "mutation_type": "strengthen_no_unrelated_action_rule",
    "priority": 2,
    "reason": "Reduce extraneous or unrelated actions in output to improve minimality and correctness.",
    "edit_instruction": "Add micro-rules to emit only actions required by the command and remove unrelated reads, duplicates, or invented wrappers.",
    "proposed_micro_rule": "Emit only actions required by the command; remove unrelated reads, duplicate actions, and invented wrappers."
  },
  {
    "target_block_id": "02",
    "target_block_family": "Service_Mapping",
    "mutation_type": "add_micro_rule",
    "priority": 1,
    "reason": "Improve service name grounding and argument type correctness to reduce schema violations and unknown service errors.",
    "edit_instruction": "Add micro-rules to use only canonical service and value names from the service list snippet and to copy enum values exactly as specified.",
    "proposed_micro_rule": "Use only canonical service/value names from service_list_snippet; never invent helper methods. For ENUM arguments, copy an allowed enum value exactly; for numeric arguments, use unquoted numeric literals."
  }
]
